headline: ‘She’ll outdo herself’: Céline Dion fans camp out for glimpse of star before sold-out Paris comeback
context: Singer has rewarded patience of hundreds waiting outside hotel with regular appearances and even some dancing Noëlla Lamy, 52, who described herself as one of Céline Dion ’s biggest fans, was preparing to spend all night on a Paris pavement without a tent but wearing a sweatshirt

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Singer has rewarded patience of hundreds waiting outside hotel with regular appearances and even some dancing Noëlla Lamy, 52, who described herself as one of Céline Dion ’s biggest fans, was preparing to spend all night on a Paris pavement without a tent but wearing a sweatshirt printed with the singer’s face for comfort. “Céline Dion is a force of bravery and an inspiration,” she said.
